news.headline: Kyiv region strike death toll rises to 38, Zelenskiy says
news.body: A Russian strike on an ammunition depot in Ukraine's Kyiv region has killed at least 38 people and left several missing, officials said. The attack, one of the deadliest in the area this year, has raised concerns about escalating strikes on the capital and prompted sustained emergency response and contamination-control work.
